name: System+
description: Raycast's System commands for Asyar: Empty Trash, Open Trash, Sleep Displays, Screen Saver, Show Desktop, Hide/Quit apps, Eject Disks, Volume, Appearance, Hidden Files, Stage Manager, Do Not Disturb, Focus Session, Window extras (fullscreen, larger/smaller, move, displays, sixths).
author: Nassim Lecornet

preferences.name: warnBeforeEmptyingTrash
preferences.title: Show Warning Before Emptying Trash
preferences.description: Ask for confirmation before the Trash is emptied.

preferences.name: focusMinutes
preferences.title: Focus Session Length (minutes)
preferences.description: Length of a focus session started with Start Focus Session.

commands.name: Empty Trash
commands.description: Empty the Trash.

commands.name: Open Trash
commands.description: Open the Trash in Finder.

commands.name: Sleep Displays
commands.description: Put the displays to sleep.

commands.name: Show Screen Saver
commands.description: Start the screen saver.

commands.name: Show Desktop
commands.description: Hide every app and show the desktop.

commands.name: Hide All Apps Except Frontmost
commands.description: Hide every app except the one in front.

commands.name: Quit All Apps
commands.description: Quit every open application.

commands.name: Quit All Apps Except Frontmost
commands.description: Quit every app except the one in front.

commands.name: Eject All Disks
commands.description: Eject every ejectable disk.

commands.name: Toggle Mute
commands.description: Mute or unmute the speaker.

commands.name: Turn Volume Up
commands.description: Raise the volume by 10%.

commands.name: Turn Volume Down
commands.description: Lower the volume by 10%.

commands.name: Set Volume to 0%
commands.description: Set the output volume to 0%.

commands.name: Set Volume to 25%
commands.description: Set the output volume to 25%.

commands.name: Set Volume to 50%
commands.description: Set the output volume to 50%.

commands.name: Set Volume to 75%
commands.description: Set the output volume to 75%.

commands.name: Set Volume to 100%
commands.description: Set the output volume to 100%.

commands.name: Toggle System Appearance
commands.description: Switch between light and dark mode.

commands.name: Toggle Hidden Files
commands.description: Show or hide hidden files in Finder.

commands.name: Toggle Stage Manager
commands.description: Turn Stage Manager on or off.

commands.name: Toggle Bluetooth
commands.description: Turn Bluetooth on or off (uses blueutil if installed, else opens Bluetooth settings).

commands.name: Dismiss Notifications
commands.description: Clear every banner in Notification Center.

commands.name: Toggle Do Not Disturb
commands.description: Turn Do Not Disturb on or off (runs your 'Toggle Do Not Disturb' Shortcut).

commands.name: Start Focus Session
commands.description: 25 minutes: Do Not Disturb on, other apps hidden, a notification when time is up.

commands.name: End Focus Session
commands.description: Stop the running focus session and turn Do Not Disturb off.

commands.name: Toggle Fullscreen
commands.description: Enter or leave native fullscreen for the front window.

commands.name: Make Larger
commands.description: Grow the front window by 10% around its center.

commands.name: Make Smaller
commands.description: Shrink the front window by 10% around its center.

commands.name: Maximize Height
commands.description: Stretch the front window to the full screen height.

commands.name: Maximize Width
commands.description: Stretch the front window to the full screen width.

commands.name: Move Left
commands.description: Nudge the front window 50 px left.

commands.name: Move Right
commands.description: Nudge the front window 50 px right.

commands.name: Move Up
commands.description: Nudge the front window 50 px up.

commands.name: Move Down
commands.description: Nudge the front window 50 px down.

commands.name: Next Display
commands.description: Move the front window to the next display, keeping its relative size and position.

commands.name: Previous Display
commands.description: Move the front window to the previous display.

commands.name: Top Center Sixth
commands.description: Front window → top center sixth of the screen.

commands.name: Bottom Center Sixth
commands.description: Front window → bottom center sixth of the screen.
